page.layout: Running head "NOTÆ" at top, page number "135" at top right. One main text column on the left, from top to bottom. A narrow margin on the right holds one marginal note ("* In" with Arabic), beside the first paragraph. Catchword "vetuit" at the lower right under the column. Signature "T" at the lower left under the column.

main_text.p: quem infiderent, secum assumpto, cavebant. Morem hunc paulò aliter describit Sharestanius; solitos scil. mortui hæredes vel filios Camelam, retorto collo eidémque appenso instrato, ad mortui sepulchrum vinctam relinquere donec moreretur; nemine pabulum vel aquam præbente (ut docet Alfauharius) qui & ab aliis foveæ impositam, dum fame moreretur relinqui solitam testatur: ut & Ebnol-Athir ubi nomen [?] explicant; quo vocabatur scil. Camela isti fato destinata unde quidam, Calamitatibus oppressos [?] Camelis quarum cervicibus alligata essent instrata, assimilat, referente Sharestanio; vel ut وفي [?] In* Alfauharius paulò aliter [?] i. Camelis quarum capita instratis obvolvta, quibus scil. tristissimum fatum subeundum erat. Hi qui judicium expectabant futurum, ideò se Idola colere prætendebant ut essent illa [?] i. e. intercessores pro ipsis apud Deum in vitâ futurâ, referente Sharestanio.

Erant & ex illis (asserente eodem) qui [?] i. e. [?] quandam credebant; scil. cûm quis occideretur vel moreretur, è sanguine, qui circa cerebrum, collecto oriri avem [?] Hamah dictam, quæ singulis subinde annorum centuriis ipsius sepulchrum viseret: vel ut Alfauharius, Ebnol Athir, & AlDamirius, eorum sententiam referunt, spiritum seu animam injuriâ interfecti in avem istam transmigrare, eâmque [?] i. e. Bibendum mihi prabete, Bibendum mihi prabete, scil. [?] i. e. de sanguine ejus qui me interfecit (ut exprimit AlDamirius,) clamantem tamdiu persistere donec de homicida vindicta sumeretur, tum demum avolare. Credi hoc vetuit

page.notes: Arabic, Greek and Hebrew passages are transcribed approximately; each word that could not be read with certainty is marked [?]. The Arabic in the first paragraph ("nomen ..."), the Arabic and Greek in the second paragraph ("qui ...", "μετεμψύχωσιν"), and the Arabic gloss "i. e. ... ejus qui me interfecit" are doubtful. The right-hand marginal note is "* In" with Arabic, read as "وفي ... In". The catchword "vetuit" is doubtful and may read "venit". The line "Credi hoc" is cut off at the column edge. The reference "T" below the column is read as the signature.
